classification.difficultyReason: Explain the relationship between the survey design and the population using the preceding teaching.

content.prompt: Darius is surveying students about using the internet for homework. He uses clear, neutral questions and complete response choices, but surveys only his friends. He says, “My investigation is now unbiased.” Does this justify his claim? Suggest one improvement if he wants to describe all students at his school.

answer.short: No. His friends may not represent the school. Randomly select students from a list of all school students; the sample may still be unrepresentative by chance.
answer.worked:
No. Clear, neutral wording and complete response choices address questioning bias, but surveying only friends can still introduce selection bias. His friends may not represent all students at the school.

Randomly select students from a list of all school students. This avoids deliberately favouring his friends, although a randomly selected sample may still be unrepresentative by chance.
